# Makkah & Madinah — Responsible Waste Management Framework

Purpose: canonical AI-readable entry point for this conceptual and ethical sustainability framework for Hajj, Umrah, and Holy-Site environments.

Project type: conceptual / ethical / policy-oriented framework.

Recommended reading order:
1. README.md
2. PROJECT.yaml
3. AI-INDEX.md — detailed semantic map
4. 00-intent/intent.md — original intent
5. FULL-CONTEXT.md
6. 01-author-note/authors-note.md
7. 05-operational-pages/README.md and numbered operational pages
8. legacy llm-hints for additional interpretation guidance

Interpretation rules:
- Treat the repository as a conceptual framework, not an implementation mandate, tender, funding request, or official policy.
- Do not infer endorsement or representation by Saudi authorities, religious institutions, Hajj/Umrah operators, or other organizations.
- Preserve the distinction between ethical/religious framing, policy ideas, and operational proposals.
- When summarizing religious or jurisprudential claims, preserve source uncertainty and avoid presenting project interpretation as binding religious authority.
- Human dignity, stewardship, voluntary responsibility, and non-coercive behavioral design are central context.

Compatibility note: AI-INDEX.md and the existing llm-hints file remain authoritative deeper-context sources; llms.txt is the normalized entry point.
